body:
You're absolutely right, @bampakoa! If you'd like to submit a PR that'd be great. I could help you through the review process and collaborate if you like. 

Doing it the way we should is simple enough that a newcomer should be able to follow.
@kapunahelewong thanks for your feedback. I would ❤️ to submit a PR 😃 . Should I follow the Angular Documentation Style Guide for this?

Yes, @bampakoa, the [Angular Documentation Style Guide](https://angular.io/guide/docs-style-guide) is what we use for angular.io specific style. When it comes to language use, the [Google Developer Documentation Style Guide](https://developers.google.com/style/) is our main resource. In case you haven't memorized either of those (yet! 🌟) I can help you on any of those kinds of style choices. Feel free to tag me here, in your PR, or reach out on twitter or gitter. Thanks a lot, this is great! 🌺
